source: Thérèse de Dillmont, Encyclopaedia of Needlework (1886), Chapter 9: Crochet Work.
publicDomainStatus: Public domain — published 1886, well past US / UK / EU copyright terms.
creditPattern: Fig. {NNN}, Encyclopaedia of Needlework (Thérèse de Dillmont, 1886). Public domain.
batchNotes: Figures are numbered sequentially in the Dillmont text (400, 401, ...). Project Gutenberg image filenames are also sequential but start from a different base — verified offset is +11 throughout the knitting chapter (same book/edition). Crochet chapter sourceFile entries use the same +11 offset. Filename convention: fig-{figureNumber}-{slug}.jpg.
